title: Lava Chicken music disc in 1.21.1
description: A simple data pack that backports the (in?)famous music disc from 1.21.7 to 1.21.1+.
body:
Just a simple data pack that allows you to hear the Lava Chicken music by Hyper Potions, added in 1.21.7. In order to see the disc texture and hear the music, it is required to also install [a resource pack](https://modrinth.com/project/supporting-resource-pack-for-lava-chicken-in-1.21.1-datapack). Without it, you will see disc 11 rather than disc ~~KFC~~ Lava Chicken. When playing the disc you should hear nothing.

I personally am not a fan of Mojang adding it to the base game, it fits better in an April Fool's version imo. Anyway, my friends want it, so I made this. Don't expect older versions as I'm too lazy; I will try to support 1.21.4-1.21.6 (it's mainly the new resource pack format, hopefully not too hard to learn).
